author: LadyLeigh
name: Echo
short: Privately ask Paimon to echo a message as the bot owner.
description: Owner-only slash command that posts a normal bot message in the current channel or a channel specified by mention, link, or ID. Confirmations and errors are private.
install_msg: Load echo, then run [p]slash enable echo and [p]slash sync. Use /echo message:Hello! or start the message with a channel mention, channel link, or ID.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store user data.
